body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea LINE FIELD, lensing drawn as in image[2]: a crisp matte black block whose front, top and grip end carry one continuous field of fine raised ridges with light-grey crests. Over the grip they stand straight and vertical at 2.4 mm pitch as grip ribs; toward the lens they bow round it and crowd to 0.6 mm pitch until they fuse into a solid black band hugging the ring: light cannot escape. On top they part round the shutter collar like round a smaller mass; flash window and two light-pipe dots sit where lines open. image[3] = such ridges as a real moulded surface. image[4] = ribbed ring with red index triangle, for the lens ring; one red ridge is the index line. Vent slots cut in the bottom valleys, plug cover with exhaust slots on the left end, corner eyelet, shadow-gap seam at the back. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws

Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized upright camera, 39 W x 57 H x 33 D mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact upright block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring upper right, flash window upper left, shutter top front-left, slide switch top rear right, USB-C in the bottom. Idea RELATIVISTIC JET: matte black body = the black hole, lens = its centre. Along the spin axis a slender satin light-grey column set into the front runs from the lens up over the top edge and down to the bottom edge: two jets fired from the poles. Its raised ring knots, tight near the lens and spreading toward the ends, are finger ribs. A thin knife-edge disc crosses it horizontally at the lens, an accretion disk seen edge-on. On top it ends in a machined cap with the slide switch and two light-pipe dots; below in a ribbed foot ring with vent slots round the USB-C, so it stands to charge. image[2] = upright tube body, satin finish. image[3] = vertical machined column with stacked rings. image[4] = ribbed ring with red index triangle, for the lens. Knurled side panel, plug cover, corner eyelet, shadow-gap seam. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized upright camera, 39 W x 57 H x 33 D mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact upright block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring upper right, flash window upper left, shutter top front-left, slide switch top rear right, USB-C in the bottom. Idea CRYSTAL TO ASH, a phase change: the lower body is an ordered faceted crystal plinth in translucent PLA with crisp planar facets, glowing faintly from the charge light at the USB-C. Moving up, the facets turn opaque light grey and crack into a Voronoi mosaic with widening black joints; the tiles crumble into grains; round the lens everything is black, granular fuzzy-skin texture like ash, the swirl into the void of image[2]. Only the lens sits in a small, perfectly smooth gloss-black dome with an engraved scale like image[3]: a black hole has no hair. Soft upright volume like image[4]. Facets give the grip, Voronoi joints over the electronics are vents. Collared shutter, recessed switch, red index triangle on the lens ring, frosted flash window, strap eyelet, shadow-gap seam. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA.
